concept: Redshift: columnar MPP warehouse for sustained petabyte-scale analytics
tests: Choosing a service for predictable, sustained analytical queries on a petabyte-scale data warehouse.
expected: Amazon Redshift — columnar MPP data warehouse. Triggers: "petabyte-scale", "columnar data warehouse", "predictable, sustained queries", "reporting".
why_not: Athena — for ad hoc, more expensive under sustained heavy load; DynamoDB — NoSQL; RDS for MySQL — row-based OLTP.
